scope: Tranche3: controlled 100/300 generated known-fit full growth; distinct secondary shape/detail/seed/supplied/direct/non-fit observations; 1000 deferred.

measurement_policy.primary: Three separate serial processes per final group; root execution evidence records windows. No failed baseline or context single enters a speedup denominator.
measurement_policy.secondary: One observation per registered case; neither stable timings nor population success rates are established.
measurement_policy.aggregation: Median/min/max include all reported outcomes; success requires exact target, physical serialized-output validation, retained artifacts and saved-run geometry loading. Studio rendering is separate evidence.
measurement_policy.nested_timings: Local preparation/setup(including teardown)/dependency solve/postcheck are disjoint. Callback times are subsets of dependency solve; do not add them. Broader pack_scene/packing_engine stages also contain sub-stages.
measurement_policy.source: Compiled source hashes are embedded configure-time metadata. Binary SHA is runner-recorded. The shared base revision alone does not identify a dirty implementation; source maps distinguish baseline, threading and retry variants.
measurement_policy.nulls: Absent historical fields mean not recorded, not zero. Physical validation unavailable on incomplete packing is not a validation pass.
measurement_policy.pose_hash: SHA-256 of benchmark placements serialized by Python json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False), UTF-8. File hashes attest exact retained bytes.
measurement_policy.work_hash: Canonical JSON SHA-256 with the same encoding as pose_hash, recursively excluding elapsed_milliseconds, stage_microseconds, timings_nanoseconds, threading and threading_mixed. Numerical results and work counters remain; physical_collision_work_sha256 hashes the complete collision-work object separately.
measurement_policy.pilots: Exploratory pilots may overlap short verification work; only final groups support registered timing acceptance. Preliminary v1 fixtures differ from constant-aspect v2 and remain separate.

registration_basis.note: First 100-object v1 pilot established a successful full-growth baseline before target selection. Controlled comparisons use v2 constant-aspect fixtures; v1 numbers are preliminary and not a before/after comparator.

primary_cases.fixture_revision_note: Final formatting and clean-checkout test integration changes the generator hash only; all 24 STL files and 18 fit witnesses are byte-identical to the v2 files used in controlled pilots.

secondary_cases: Direct full-size placement, separate from growth
Supplied 768-face STL with uniformly scaled containers at 16.967% density
record.measurement_policy: Retain all attempted outcomes; three separate serial processes per final comparator, no concurrent project builds/tests/UI. Record source/input/executable hashes, resolved work/time/thread settings, nested timing attribution and process CPU/peak memory. Failed before runs are not speedup denominators. Timings do not become ordinary CTest thresholds.
record.threading_candidate: Packing default requests one task-scoped OpenMP thread through the existing pinned runtime; explicit zero retains inherited setting. No process environment mutation or independent concurrent local solves. MKL thread environment overrides are reported separately. Full packing placements may change; exact target and physical invariants remain required.
not_claimed: General convergence for arbitrary shape, density or seed
100/300 full-size supplied objects in the original too-small container
Hard preemption or hard native allocation caps

retry_reuse_candidate.selected_after: Controlled v2 thread-only 300-object pilot still reaches the 300-second limit at seven of nine barriers. Rejected batches account for 57-65% of local calls in the controlled baseline profiles.
retry_reuse_candidate.policy: Retain one immediate rejected batch and only unchanged successful local results; preserve full physical checks, ordered logical requests, RNG draws and cancellation. Count actual and reused work separately.

triangle_index_candidate.selected_after: Secondary supplied100 growth exhausts the physical triangle-pair allowance at three of nine barriers in 69.517 seconds.
triangle_index_candidate.policy: Keep exact VTK contacts and the exhaustive oracle. Bound index construction, traversal, candidates and logical memory; prune only when a conservative certificate proves the existing VTK same-plane-side early return. Fail open for uncertain arithmetic.
triangle_index_candidate.additional_gate: Retain the supplied100 outcome and measure its limiting work after indexing; re-run the full physical/output, supported build and Studio gates. Known-fit primary100/300 growth still requires three successes each.
triangle_index_candidate.status: Rejected after measurement; removed from delivered implementation

primary100.decision: Slower than the retained retry policy.

outcomes.container_prepass: Uncompiled, untested, unmeasured draft; not adopted

policy: Run serially after final verification and outside other measured processes.
Each secondary case has one observation; these are not stable timing estimates or success-rate claims.
Retain every algorithm failure and available canonical artifact. Continue to the next registered case.
Cooperative300-second engine deadline excludes bounded input preparation/initialization and is not hard process preemption.
Do not substitute near-target or direct placement for genuine growth.
Native OpenMP/MKL environment overrides are recorded by the executable; this script does not alter them.

delivered_source_restoration.scope: All source files hashed at configure for the delivered retry benchmark; exact byte equality restored after removing rejected index experiment.

secondary.policy: One serial observation per secondary case; retain failures; no convergence or stable timing estimate is implied.

record.scope: Thread control and retry reuse before triangle broad phase; preserved after passing all matrices and desktop checks.
